title: Anna's Choice of Career
text:
Anna is sixteen and studies at a school in Lviv. She likes mathematics and physics, so she wants to become an engineer. Every Tuesday she goes to a robotics club after school.

Last summer she worked at a small repair shop for two weeks. The owner showed her how to fix old computers. Anna says this experience helped her decide that engineering is the right career for her.

questions.text: How long did Anna work at the repair shop?
Why does Anna go to the robotics club?
options: She is interested in building machines
She wants to become a professional dancer
Her friends asked her to join
She has to teach the other members

questions.text: What can the reader conclude about Anna's future plans?
options: She will probably study engineering at university
She has decided to stop studying science
She will become a history teacher

vocabulary.definition: a person who designs or builds machines, roads or systems
knowledge or skills you get from doing something
to fix something that is broken

paragraph_translations: Анна має шістнадцять років і навчається у школі у Львові. Їй подобаються математика та фізика, тому вона хоче стати інженером. Щовівторка після уроків вона ходить до гуртка робототехніки.

Минулого літа вона дві тижні працювала в невеликій майстерні з ремонту. Власник показав їй, як лагодити старі комп'ютери. Анна каже, що цей досвід допоміг їй вирішити, що інженерія — правильний вибір для неї.
